description: api-node server work for ALL issues: (Issue 1) big-picture push images with absolute-HTTPS URL resolution; (Issue 4) carry product deep-link + image through the broadcast route (mobile routing already wired, server-only change); (Issue 3) Notification + NotificationRecipient persistence (raw-SQL tables + Prisma models, no migrate), a history write on every send path, and GET /api/admin/notifications; (Issue 8) POST /api/admin/version to edit the app_version force-update row; (Issue 7) opt-in keyset pagination on the staff order list + GET /api/admin/stats SQL aggregation. This FEAT is self-contained in api-node and is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 (web) and FEAT-003 (mobile). All DB changes follow the repo's no-migrate convention (information_schema-guarded raw SQL + schema.prisma models declared WITHOUT prisma migrate).
steps: Issue 1 — in api-node/src/services/push.ts: add `image?: string` to the PushMessage interface (~L41); add a small `absolutePublicUrl(src)` helper that imports SITE_ORIGIN from '../seo/origin' and returns src unchanged when it matches /^https?:/ else `${SITE_ORIGIN}/${src.replace(/^\.?\//,'')}` (mirror routes/og.ts absoluteImageUrl). In androidConfig(msg) (~L52) set notification.imageUrl = absolutePublicUrl(msg.image) ONLY when msg.image is present; in sendToTopic (~L68) and sendToTokens/sendEachForMulticast (~L127) set the top-level notification.image = absolutePublicUrl(msg.image) ONLY when present. Text-only pushes MUST remain byte-identical (no image keys emitted when msg.image is empty).

Issue 4 (server) + Issue 1 plumbing — in api-node/src/routes/push.ts: add `image: z.string().optional()` to sendSchema (~L69) and pass it into the PushMessage built in POST /send (~L76). Keep the existing `link` passthrough into data.link unchanged (mobile already routes /product/:id).

Issue 3 schema — in api-node/prisma/schema.prisma add model Notification { id BigInt @id @default(autoincrement()) @db.UnsignedBigInt, type String @db.VarChar(40), title String @db.VarChar(255), body String @db.Text, image String? @db.VarChar(500), link String? @db.VarChar(500), target String @db.VarChar(40), product_id BigInt? @db.UnsignedBigInt, order_id String? @db.VarChar(20), sent_by String? @db.VarChar(64), success_count Int @default(0), failure_count Int @default(0), created_at DateTime @default(now()), @@index([created_at], map: "idx_notifications_created"), @@index([product_id], map: "idx_notifications_product"), @@map("notifications") } and model NotificationRecipient { id BigInt @id @default(autoincrement()) @db.UnsignedBigInt, notification_id BigInt @db.UnsignedBigInt, user_id BigInt? @db.UnsignedBigInt, token String @db.VarChar(255), status String @db.VarChar(20), created_at DateTime @default(now()), @@index([notification_id], map: "idx_notif_recipient_notif"), @@index([user_id], map: "idx_notif_recipient_user"), @@map("notification_recipients") }. Do NOT run prisma migrate or db push.

Issue 3 bootstrap — in api-node/src/services/dataImport.ts add `export async function ensureNotificationTables()` that runs information_schema-guarded `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notifications (...)` and `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notification_recipients (...)` via prisma.$executeRawUnsafe, matching the ensurePlainPasswordColumn style (column types mirroring the Prisma models above; InnoDB utf8mb4). In api-node/src/server.ts call `ensureNotificationTables().catch(...)` next to the existing seedDefaultOwner() call inside app.listen.

Issue 3 write + read — in api-node/src/services/push.ts add `recordNotification(meta, tokens, successCount, failureCount)` that inserts one notifications row and bulk-inserts notification_recipients (resolve user_id from device_tokens by token with a single query where possible; status 'sent'/'failed' is best-effort). Call it from the broadcast path (routes/push.ts POST /send) and from the targeted senders (sendToTopic/sendToTokens used by notifyStaffNewOrder/notifyCustomerStatus) passing the right type/target/order_id/product_id. Wrap every history write in try/catch so a logging failure NEVER blocks the push. Add `GET /api/admin/notifications` behind requireStaff('ads') (in routes/push.ts) with optional ?userId=, ?productId= filters and keyset pagination ?limit=&cursor= (clamp limit 1..200), returning { notifications, nextCursor }.

Issue 7 pagination — in api-node/src/routes/orders.ts GET / staff branch (the `staff && !mobile` block ~L38): accept optional query `limit` (clamp 1..200) and `cursor` (numeric id). When present, findMany({ where: cursor ? { id: { lt: BigInt(cursor) } } : {}, orderBy: { id: 'desc' }, take: limit }) and return { orders, nextCursor } (nextCursor = last row id or null). When BOTH absent, keep the exact current unpaginated behaviour and response shape. Do NOT trim row fields (mobile staff list reuses full fields). Leave the customer branch and GET /:orderId untouched.

Issue 7 stats — add `GET /api/admin/stats` behind requireStaff('dashboard') (fallback to a permission that exists if needed) in api-node/src/routes/admin.ts: run SQL GROUP BY aggregates via prisma.$queryRawUnsafe for today/month/all-time revenue on order_status='Delivered', per-status counts, top 5 products by quantity, and out-of-stock count from products. Return a small flat JSON shape (document the field names in the FEAT findings so FEAT-002 can consume it).

Issue 8 — add `POST /api/admin/version` behind requireStaff('settings') in api-node/src/routes/admin.ts: zod-validate version_code (int>0), version_name (string<=20), url (string<=500, https or empty), message (string), force_update (bool); run parameterised `UPDATE app_version SET version_code=?, version_name=?, url=?, message=?, force_update=? WHERE id=1` and return the row in the same shape as GET /api/version.
acceptance_criteria: `cd api-node && npm install && npm run build` compiles with no TypeScript errors.
`cd api-node && npx prisma validate` reports the schema is valid (Notification + NotificationRecipient models present).
PushMessage has an optional image field and image keys are emitted to FCM ONLY when image is present (text-only payload unchanged).
sendSchema accepts optional image; data.link passthrough is preserved.
ensureNotificationTables exists, is information_schema/IF-NOT-EXISTS guarded, and is called at startup in server.ts.
GET /api/admin/notifications is guarded by requireStaff('ads') and supports userId/productId filters + limit/cursor.
GET / staff order list accepts optional limit/cursor (keyset id desc) and is unchanged when both are absent.
GET /api/admin/stats returns SQL-aggregated revenue/status/top-products/out-of-stock without returning the full orders table.
POST /api/admin/version is guarded by requireStaff('settings'), validates inputs, and updates app_version WHERE id=1 via a parameterised query.
No prisma migrate / db push was run; schema.prisma edited by hand only.

== GET /api/admin/stats response shape (FEAT-002 consume) ==
Response is wrapped by ok() as { success: true, data: { ...fields below } }. Fields:
- revenue: { today: number, month: number, allTime: number }  (Delivered orders only; today=order_date today, month=current year+month, allTime=all Delivered)
- deliveredOrders: number  (count of Delivered orders)
- totalOrders: number  (sum of all per-status counts)
- statusCounts: object keyed by order_status string -> number (e.g. { "Order Placed": 3, "Delivered": 10 })
- topProducts: array of { productId: number|null, name: string, quantity: number } (top 5 by qty sold, desc)
- outOfStock: number  (products with in_stock=0)

== GET /api/admin/notifications response shape (FEAT-002 consume) ==
Guard requireStaff('ads'). Query params: ?limit= (1..200, default 50), ?cursor= (numeric id, keyset lt), ?userId= (numeric; filters to notifications delivered to that user via notification_recipients), ?productId= (numeric). Response wrapped by ok() as { success: true, data: { notifications, nextCursor } }:
- notifications: array of { id: number, type: string, title: string, body: string, image: string|null, link: string|null, target: string, productId: number|null, orderId: string|null, sentBy: string|null, successCount: number, failureCount: number, createdAt: Date }, ordered id DESC.
- nextCursor: string|null  (last row id when a full page returned, else null; pass back as ?cursor=).

== Other FEAT-002/003 touchpoints ==
- POST /api/push/send now accepts optional `image` (string) and `productId` (number|string) in addition to existing target/title/body/link. data.link passthrough unchanged.
- POST /api/admin/version (requireStaff('settings')) body: { version_code:int>0, version_name:string<=20, url:string<=500 https-or-empty, message:string, force_update:bool }; returns same shape as GET /api/version: { versionCode, versionName, url, message, forceUpdate, assetVersion }.
- GET /api/orders staff list: opt-in keyset pagination via ?limit=&cursor=; when either present returns { orders, nextCursor } (nextCursor = last order.id string or null), when BOTH absent returns the original { orders } unchanged.
